context: A mom answers her young son's endless questions
purpose: Teach: メイク/ストップ/不自由/無知/文字通り/はぁ/比べれ/尋ねる

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ねえママ、なんで女の人ってメイクするの？
lines.en: Hey Mom, why do women wear makeup?
lines.style: Curious child voice, rising tone, innocent and bright

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うーん、身だしなみかな。ねえ翔、ちょっと質問ストップしてくれる？
lines.en: Hmm, it's grooming I guess. Hey Sho, can you stop the questions for a sec?
lines.style: Gentle motherly tone, slightly tired but patient and warm

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: やだ！じゃあさ、体の不自由な人ってどうやってご飯食べるの？
lines.en: No way! Then, how do people with physical disabilities eat their food?
lines.style: Quick energetic child voice, no pause between thoughts, lively

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ママに尋ねるより、自分で考えてみたら？ママだって無知なこといっぱいあるのよ。
lines.en: Instead of asking Mom, why don't you think for yourself? Mom doesn't know lots of things either.
lines.style: Soft amused maternal tone, playful redirect, slightly chuckling

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: でもさ、僕の友達のケンくんと比べれば、ママの方が物知りだよ！
lines.en: But you know, compared to my friend Ken, Mom knows way more stuff!
lines.style: Excited proud child tone, fast cheerful delivery, bright cadence

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: はぁ、それは褒められてるのかしら…文字通り朝から晩までしゃべってるわね。
lines.en: Sigh, I wonder if that's a compliment... You literally talk from morning till night.
lines.style: Long sigh, fond exasperation, slow warm motherly cadence

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: だってママと話すの楽しいんだもん！
lines.en: Because talking with you is fun, Mom!
lines.style: Sweet earnest child voice, bright affectionate closing tone
